Categories.value: Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike missing SDC copyright status|Self-published work|Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0 missing SDC copyright license|Self-published work missing SDC copyright license|Images from Wiki Loves Food 2026 in India|Uploaded via Campaign:Wiki Loves Food 2026 in India

ImageDescription.value:
Laai Patot Bhapot Diya Chicken (Steamed Chicken Wrapped in Mustard Greens)

Recipe: Marinate the chicken with garlic, ginger and green chilly paste; add cinnamon, elashi and other masala's as you like; add salt, turmeric powder, black paper powder and butter. Keep it in a deep freeze for 15 minutes. In that time clean the mustard greens. Add some drops of cooking oil (e.g. mustard oil) on the leafs. Now according to the size of the chicken pieces put 2/3 in the middle of one leaf and warped it.

Keep your pan hot. Add another 2/3 drops of cocking oil on the pan and brush it. Now add your warped chicken into it. Cook on low flame for 25/30 minutes and your special dish is ready to be served.
